div.p:
INSTANCES REGISTER THEIR ACTUAL ADDRESS WITH A REGISTRY ON START
AND DEREGISTER ON STOP. CLIENTS RESOLVE A LOGICAL NAME THROUGH THE
REGISTRY INSTEAD OF HARD-CODING A HOST AND PORT.

ul.li:
DEV/PORTS.D2 — THE PROGRESSION FROM STATIC HARD-CODED PORTS,
TO A DYNAMIC ALLOCATOR, TO AN EPHEMERAL-PORT PROTOCOL IS EXACTLY
THE ARGUMENT FOR A REGISTRY OVER FIXED ADDRESSES.
